title: Apply for a combined driver licence and boat licence
summary: You can apply to combine your existing NSW driver licence and boat licence onto a single card.
intro:
If you have a boat licence and a driver licence, you can apply to combine the two licences onto one card. There is no change to the way each of the licences are obtained.

The combined licence looks like a NSW Driver Licence, with an indicator on the reverse side of the card that shows the licence holder also has a NSW boat licence.

You can only apply for a combined licence:

Note: Combined licences cannot be renewed online.
who_can_apply: You hold an unrestricted driver licence of any class (including rider, heavy vehicle).
Your driver licence is due or eligible for renewal.
The name and date of birth on your driver licence and boat licence match.
Your driver licence and boat licence (including personal watercraft) are current, or not expired more than 5 years.
You hold a young adult general boat or young adult personal watercraft licence, or a gratis boat licence.
You must meet all listed criteria.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Licence Renewal Application – PDF.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: You must agree to align your boat licence expiry date with your driver licence expiry date, and pay the necessary fees.
Your driver licence renewal period must have an expiry date that is greater than your current boat licence expiry date (boat licence expiry dates can only be extended, not reduced).
There's no additional fee for the combined licence.
You can opt out of your combined licence at any time, and your driver licence and boat licence will be reprinted at no cost.
If you surrender your licence voluntarily, you'll receive a pro rata refund of both, or either, licence components.
You'll get a renewal notice for your combined licence about 6 weeks before it's due to expire.

faqs.q: How does the combined licence look?
faqs.a: The combined licence looks like a NSW Driver Licence, with an indicator on the reverse side of the card that shows you also have a NSW boat licence.

faqs.q: Can I renew the combined licence online?
faqs.a: No, combined licences cannot be renewed online.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my combined licence application?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to submit your application.
